lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hey, Producer.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: How was the show?
I really enjoyed it!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: We had a bit of a snafu with the audio in the middle...
Sure, but you resolved it almost immediately.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You mean when I sang without the background music?
Yes, it was amazing!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: That's because I didn't want to keep my fans waiting

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: until the backing track was fixed.
Hearing your voice acapella was spectacular.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: How about the stage production? Did you enjoy the choreographed drones?
Absolutely amazing!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You see,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I told you that you wouldn't regret coming.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: What else did you like?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'd love to hear your opinion

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so I can incorporate it into the next show.
I liked everything!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Okay, that's nice, but could you perhaps be more specific?
Hmm... I particularly liked it when you blew me a kiss.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I did?
Don't you remember? It was during the last chorus of the first song.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: The venue is quite large,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: and the audience area wasn't lit,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so I doubt I'd be able to

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: blow a kiss in your direction.
Impossible, we made eye contact like 3 times!
No way, you totally found me!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Weeeell...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: When the spotlight moved across the audience momentarily,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I might have seen you.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Just for a brief moment.
I'm glad I wore that shirt and made myself stick out.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I've gotta get back to working on my new tune.
